text: Assignment due Friday, reply to Priya's email, reorganise my bookmarks, water the plant, maybe learn guitar someday

tasks.title: Assignment
tasks.reason: It has a stated deadline of Friday and is probably the biggest task on the list, so slipping costs the most.
tasks.next_step: Open the assignment and write down what is still missing.
tasks.excuse: A seagull took the only copy of the instructions.

tasks.title: Reply to Priya's email
tasks.reason: A short reply clears one open item. No deadline was stated.
tasks.next_step: Write a two-line reply and send it.
tasks.minimum_effort: Send a short answer, or a date you will answer by.
tasks.excuse: The email is stuck behind a very polite pigeon.

tasks.title: Water the plant
tasks.reason: It takes a minute and a plant cannot wait forever. No deadline was stated.
tasks.next_step: Fill a glass and water it.
tasks.minimum_effort: Give it one glass of water and move on.
tasks.excuse: The plant says it is fine. The plant is lying.

tasks.title: Reorganise my bookmarks
tasks.reason: No deadline, and nothing else on the list depends on it.
tasks.next_step: If you start, set a ten-minute timer.
tasks.minimum_effort: Delete the ten bookmarks you recognise least.
tasks.excuse: The bookmarks are in a union dispute.
tasks.permit_clause: someone asks where a bookmark went

tasks.title: Learn guitar
tasks.reason: You wrote "maybe" and "someday", so there is no plan and no deadline.
tasks.minimum_effort: Nothing needed. It can stay an idea.
tasks.excuse: Every guitar in the area is on strike.

raw.smallest_next_action: Open the assignment and list what is still missing.
clarifying_questions: How long is the assignment, and how much of it is done?
raw.official_notice: One assignment is due Friday. The guitar has waited this long.

text: Pay the electricity bill by the 25th, book a dentist appointment, clear 400 unread newsletters, call grandma

tasks.title: Pay the electricity bill
tasks.reason: It is money owed with a stated date of the 25th, so it ranks first.
tasks.next_step: Log in to your electricity account and open the bill.
tasks.minimum_effort: Pay the full amount online and skip filing the receipt.
tasks.excuse: The bill was delivered to a lighthouse.

tasks.title: Book a dentist appointment
tasks.reason: It is about your health and has no stated date, so book it soon but after the bill.
tasks.next_step: Find the dentist's number or online booking page.
tasks.minimum_effort: Book any slot in the next few weeks.
tasks.excuse: The dentist's phone number is hiding behind the couch.

tasks.title: Call grandma
tasks.reason: A short call is easy to put off, and no deadline was stated.
tasks.next_step: Text her to ask when she is free for a call.
tasks.excuse: Grandma's phone is, by tradition, in another room.

tasks.title: Clear 400 unread newsletters
tasks.reason: No deadline, and nothing in the list depends on it.
tasks.next_step: Search for "unsubscribe" and bulk-delete what you find.
tasks.minimum_effort: Select everything and mark it as read.
tasks.excuse: The newsletters multiply when nobody is looking.

raw.smallest_next_action: Open the electricity bill and pay it.
clarifying_questions: Is there a date you need the dentist appointment by?
raw.official_notice: One bill has a deadline. The newsletters do not.
